name: orquestrador-fagulha
description: Uma sala local para orquestrar seus agentes de desenvolvimento no VS Code.

scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node esbuild.mjs --test && node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/.tmp/build/test/*.test.js
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/empacotar.cjs && node scripts/verificar-privacidade.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src/extension.ts src/core src/providers src/permissions src/mcp src/storage src/attachments src/context-import src/browser src/voice test/*.ts test/package-smoke.cjs scripts/*.cjs esbuild.mjs tsconfig*.json package.json .prettierrc.json
